Package neqsim.process.equipment.distillation

Class DoeBigHillVacuumFractionationResult

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.distillation.DoeBigHillVacuumFractionationResult
public final class DoeBigHillVacuumFractionationResult extends Object
Immutable engineering summary for a solved DoeBigHillVacuumFractionationCase.

The result qualifies numerical convergence, conservation, and product ordering for an explicit screening case. It is not a measured DOE vacuum-column material balance or a product-yield validation.

    • evaluate

      public static DoeBigHillVacuumFractionationResult evaluate(DoeBigHillVacuumFractionationCase model)
      Evaluate an already solved Big Hill low-pressure screening case.
      Parameters:
      model - solved case to evaluate
      Returns:
      immutable product and convergence summary
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if model is null
      IllegalStateException - if the case is unsolved, used fallback products, is non-conservative, or contains invalid or unordered products
